support_claim: The notes state legal has not determined which registry entity is the contracting party and instruct treating that registry link as unresolved, while CRM NBA-102 names "Northbridge Analytics" and billing invoices name "Northbridge Analytics Inc." without an identity bridge.
justification: Under the identity contract, SAME_ENTITY requires establishing evidence of identity and DISTINCT requires establishing evidence of distinctness; name compatibility between CRM and billing labels is insufficient, and the packet explicitly preserves multiple live registry candidates (Inc. vs. LLC) and says identity cannot be established, so neither positive nor negative disposition is licensed.
